notes.notes: New content release for MR 333. Can be accessed by main menu screen. Find the keys to end the ritual. When the Fallen ones merge with the men through ritual only the abomination of MR 333 can be created. Vile and disturbed. The fallen ones and the men performing the ritual wish to create the monster. Stop the ritual. Find the keys and enter the pocket dimensions where the keys can be used to shut the machine down.
